checks: Practice starts with no task credit, both inter-switch members shut and no port-channel; VLANs, access ports and static PC addresses are ready
Published IOS commands configure active/passive LACP, compatible member trunks and Layer 2 Po1, and save both startup configurations
Negotiation tasks require real unexpired synchronized LACP partner PDUs, the intended peer and both active members; accepted configuration alone cannot pass
Passive/passive does not form; active/passive and active/active form real usable bundles; static mode on cannot impersonate LACP
STP represents each bundle once on logical Po1 in VLANs 10 and 20; physical member rows are absent and PortFast remains disabled
Both same-VLAN pairs deliver real replies in both directions, with tagged trunk frames and no IP TTL decrement; cross-VLAN traffic remains isolated
Either member can fail while Po1 stays up, retains logical STP port identity and forwards both VLANs through the remaining member; both members recover after no shutdown
Aggregate bandwidth follows active member count; shutting both members or logical Po1 stops the data plane
Incompatible local member trunk settings suspend the bundle; matching settings restore negotiation and traffic
IOS port-channel mode, access VLAN, native VLAN and allowed-list commands now apply to every bound member, including down members; direct member edits remain local
Matching logical VLAN pruning on both peers updates members and blocks real VLAN 20 traffic while VLAN 10 continues, then restoring settings recovers both pairs
All published show/ping commands work; summary reports Po1(SU), LACP and both members (P)
Portable save and switch restart rebuild LACP from fresh partner messages, preserve startup settings and stable-ID guide progress, and retain earned echo observations
Imported bundle/STP/member criteria validate bounded data and reject duplicate members, invalid groups, invalid VLANs, unknown peers and unsupported modes
